en.name: Constable
en.ability: You start knowing a player. If you die at night, you learn a player. One of them is a Minion & the other is an Outsider. [+1 Outsider]

revisions.v1: You start knowing a player. If you die at night, you learn a player. One of them is a Minion & the other is an Outsider. [+1 Outsider]

en.otherNightReminder: If the Constable died tonight, wake them. If the player marked *KNOW* is not an Outsider, point to an Outsider player. If the player marked *KNOW* is not a Minion, point to a Minion player.

zh.name: 治安官
zh.ability: 在你的首个夜晚，你会得知一名玩家。如果你在夜晚死亡，你会得知一名玩家。他们中一人是爪牙，另一人是外来者。[+1外来者]

revisions.v1: 在你的首个夜晚，你会得知一名玩家。如果你在夜晚死亡，你会得知一名玩家。他们中一人是爪牙，另一人是外来者。[+1外来者]

zh.firstNightReminder: 告知他被放置“得知”提示标记的玩家。
zh.otherNightReminder: 如果他在当晚死亡，唤醒他。如果被放置“得知”提示标记的玩家不是外来者，告知他一名外来者玩家。如果被放置“得知”提示标记的玩家不是爪牙，告知他一名爪牙玩家。
